problem_type: Existing resource action removed outside authorized scope
symptom: Legacy storyboard context menu lacks delete while document delete remains
direct_cause: Sidebar delete renderer was narrowed to document targets
class_root: Shared resource menu did not preserve target-dispatched existing actions
affected_population: Existing legacy storyboard resources in creation sidebar
internal_only_reason: Internal restoration of existing menu and deletion owner; no external API changes
invariants: Document and storyboard resource menus dispatch deletion to their existing target owners after confirmation

door_reduction.why_not: The restored menu must read the existing owner action and dispatch confirmed deletion; no second deletion owner is introduced.

generality_proof: Both resource targets use the same menu entry; target identity is captured before asynchronous confirmation.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Render existing resource actions and dispatch confirmed deletion by target kind

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Browser clicks legacy menu, cancels, then confirms and checks actual store-backed rows
Browser deletes document and verifies last document remains protected

recurrence.reason: Every legacy resource lost the same shared action
same_class_scan: Compared both document and storyboard context-menu targets and existing deletion owners
Before repair deleteStoryboardDesign door map had zero consumers; after restoring original menu it reports read/write at DocumentListSidebar.

prevention.invariant: Shared menu exposes the existing confirmed deletion for both resource kinds
prevention.failure_mode: Cancel performs no deletion; final document remains protected
prevention.strategy: Restore shared target-dispatched menu instead of separate new deletion mechanisms

legacy_paths.rationale: Restores original owner; no new parallel deletion implementation

residual_risks: Controlled browser component evidence is not Electron package acceptance
